scenes.text: Day three. You gave him a T-Rex.
Quick recap. A whale dumped him here, and his yacht is chained to the island. Forever.
And then, this comment.
Give him a T-Rex, that eats any and all food he has, every seven days.
At first, he is terrified.
Then it licks him.
And they become best friends.
Day one, it scares off the shark.
Day four, it catches him a fish.
But its arms are too short to hand it over.
So it spits it at him.
By day six, he has a whole pile of food.
Then. Day seven.
It eats everything.
The fish. The coconuts. Even the one in his hand.
It even tries the seagull.
Then, it looks at him.
And tries to give him a hug.
Day four is up to you.
A jetpack? A grandma? A second T-Rex?
Literally anything. Top comment gets built.
